# Horizyn 0.1.0 · Build 2
修复空工作区无法关闭的问题：没有终端标签页时，也可以通过关闭按钮、右键菜单或命令面板正常关闭工作区。
适用于 Apple Silicon Mac，要求 macOS 12.0 或更新版本。

item.title: Horizyn 0.1.0
item.description:
# Horizyn 0.1.0
First signed release for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or later.
- Native terminal workspaces with sessions managed by the background terminal service. - Built-in update checks, a sidebar update button, and an automatic-check preference in Settings. - Updates show the running commands in every terminal session before asking you to close them and upgrade. Choosing Upgrade Later leaves those commands running. - Updates verify the package signature before installing.
Download the DMG, drag Horizyn into Applications, and open it. Future releases can be installed from inside the app.
Upgrading closes the listed terminal sessions and interrupts their commands. Save your work before confirming. Existing development builds must close their sessions and restart their older terminal service once to move to this release.
